title: Mixed Event — Awakening Beat — Episode5 Taking the First Step

meta.Event Outline: Kohane has steadily built up experience, including performing solo at events. An, Akito and Toya all acknowledge her efforts, but Kohane herself doesn't seem confident. An and the others try to get Kohane to believe in herself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I said that I'd try to, but I really don't know what I'm actually supposed to do about it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hmm... Maybe I can look up how to do that... How to be more confident.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Tell yourself, You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, don't say that...!
I should try whatever I can!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You can do it.
You can do it! You can do it...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I'm not sure it's helping...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: What's wrong, An? You look like you're this table's best friend.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I haven't been able to come up with any good ideas!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How to make it so Kohane has more confidence in herself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do? No one's ever taught me how to actually be more confident.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've never thought about trying to be more confident...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But whenever I get up on stage, I switch to just wanting to get the crowd going as much as I possibly can, you know?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Haha. You really have been like that your whole life.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You said the same thing about performing and being on stage, dad!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait... Is that what Kohane means by having confidence...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Why don't you ask Akito and Toya about this? I mean, you're teammates, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, duh...!
I'll try calling them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito?
There's something I want to ask your opinion about...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, you're here.
Then let's get started with our meeting.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! So what are we talking about today...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, is that a flyer for a new event?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, we were just talking about it!
Check it out, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's already another one coming up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It's held periodically and it's already that time of year again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, what's happening? I can't sing as well as when we were rehearsing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, I get it. It's because the audience is so loud, it's drowning out everyone's voices!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do we do? It'll be dark soon too...! If we can't get back up, does that mean we'll...?)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Their unbelievable performance and energy just trumped everyone else's!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: EVER, the winners from last time, are supposedly gonna be in it too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're good, but based on where we are right now, I think we can beat them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It'll also give us a chance to show just how much we've improved. There's no reason not to enter.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And after talking it over with the guys, I sort of don't want to miss this opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Last time, we really screwed up, and our rep took a huge hit because of that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But if we go back and win, you'd feel a lot better about yourself too, right...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm also under the same impression.
Success seems to be the best cure, no?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I really don't think you need to be rushing to find a solution like this, but this might actually be your best bet for the time being...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So what do you think? Wanna give it a shot?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They went through all this trouble to try and help me out.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That means I shouldn't be acting so scared...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to stop looking up at that tree and just start climbing it already...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that.
I'll deal with the paperwork.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But we'll be fine... I'll be fine...! I practiced and worked so hard since then!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that's about the gist of it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So let's get started with our super special training for STAY GOLDEN!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is the super really necessary, Shiraishi? I doubt we'll be doing anything that different compared to what we usually do...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't be like that, Toya! It's just a way to get everyone hyped and ready since we're gonna be working super hard!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. I suppose that works too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's better than being way too nervous about it like a certain someone is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's good that you feel that way, Azusawa, but you may also want to relax a little more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But for today, we'll just be listening to you guys sing and saying what we think, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! I know you're always doing this for us, but we need you to be extra picky today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm really looking forward to this!
I never knew that being a judge could be this exciting, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You seem like the type that gives everyone a perfect score, KAITO.
